summary: Iter 80 — targeted backend verification of two surgical fixes: (1) MLS active-player filter in sportdb_player_scorer._picks_for_side (mirrors CSL), (2) no_bet=True inclusion in server._apply_atomic_delete _pin_filter. 23/23 pytest cases PASSED (test_iter80_mls_filter_and_no_bet_delete.py). Coverage: (A) MLS filter — mls_scorer_gate exposes _espn_names/_TOP_SCORER_INDEX/_STARTER_INDEX/_norm; closure returns True for curated top-scorer (Messi, Bouanga) both when ESPN empty and loaded, returns False for unknown names ONLY when ESPN is loaded (correctly non-blocking on cold start via None), returns None for empty input; source-level grep confirms MLS init block (is_mls gate on 'mls:' / 'soccer_usa_mls'), per-player loop uses `continue` on `verdict is False`, CSL block precedes MLS block in the loop (regression), and neither gate matches 'soccer_epl' (non-MLS leagues untouched). (B) _pin_filter — verbatim clause copied from server.py + minimal in-memory Mongo matcher: {peak=99, no_bet=True, source=the_odds_api} → deleted, {peak=99, no no_bet} / {peak=99, no_bet=False} → protected, {peak<95} / {no peak} → deleted regardless, {peak=99, no_bet=True, source in _OUT_OF_BAND_SOURCES (mls_espn_leaderboard)} → protected, {peak=99, no_bet=True, source=sportdb_scorer_v1/synth} → protected (regex guard), {peak=99, no_bet=True, is_model_only=True} → protected. Structural source check confirms new $or clause `{"no_bet": True}` is present and _pin_filter shape is intact. (C) Live Mongo integration test — seeded 5 synthetic picks on TEST_2099-01-01 with the exact _pin_filter, verified delete_many wiped ONLY the no_bet=True/the_odds_api/no is_model_only pick (deleted_count=1), and the 4 protected picks remained. (D) /api/picks/today returns HTTP 200 with valid {picks:[]} envelope twice consecutively — no 500s introduced. Backend err.log tail contains no traceback referencing sportdb_player_scorer, _pin_filter, _apply_atomic_delete, or mls_scorer_gate. Deprecated packages detected: NONE.
action_items: None blocking. Both surgical fixes verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: MLS filter (sportdb_player_scorer.py ~L736-768) faithfully mirrors the CSL contract (True/False/None) and correctly gates the ESPN-empty case with `if _mls_gate._espn_names:` before returning False. This avoids over-blocking on cold start — good.

MLS filter fallback path (ESPN empty) uses OR across _TOP_SCORER_INDEX and _STARTER_INDEX and returns None (not False) when neither hits — this means before the ESPN refresher runs, only curated names are actively confirmed; unknowns pass through. Aligns with 'don't block picks before the refresher runs' comment.

server.py _pin_filter (~L1984-2007): the new `{"no_bet": True}` clause was added as a third disjunct in the inner $or, leaving all three outer $and guards (_OUT_OF_BAND_SOURCES $nin, sportdb_scorer* $not-$regex, is_model_only $ne True) intact. Verified via unit tests that these still protect their respective sources even when no_bet=True.

Minor: the MLS init in sportdb_player_scorer wraps mls_scorer_gate import inside a broad try/except that silently sets `mls_filter_active = None` on any ImportError. This is defensive-consistent with CSL, but a missing services/mls_scorer_gate.py would go unlogged. Not blocking — current file exists and imports cleanly.

Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter80_mls_filter_and_no_bet_delete.py is safe to re-run — self-contained, loads /app/backend/.env, uses TEST_ prefix on all seed data.
